title: Second-Moment Stochastic Approximation Methods
summary: Classical stochastic approximation methods rely on estimators of the first moment (mean) of a random regression function. We study methods that employ estimators of both the first and the second moments, which include modern deep-learning optimizers such as Adam and Muon as special cases. We derive second-moment stochastic approximation methods through the lens of optimal preconditioning for solving matrix equations, and develop a two-stage framework for their convergence analysis.
